summary:
I re-verified the grounding against origin/main 15e78e276 in the read-only worktree. Most claims hold, so the verdict is MOSTLY_RELIABLE: 15 of 20 capability statuses hold and 4 are overstated. It also misses several shipped building blocks that a spec author needs.

**Confirmed by my own runs**
- **Daemon never spawns.** One iteration in /tmp with ANTIEK_HOME redirected returned skipped_reasons={'spawn_declined': 1}. run_forever defaults to no_op_spawn, and both systemd entry paths reach that default: __main__.py:44-62, calling daemon.main at daemon.py:325-334.
- **Dead budget env var.** The unit sets ANTIEK_DAEMON_BUDGET_USD_PER_DAY, but the code reads budget._ENV_DAILY_CAP, which is ANTIEK_DAEMON_HOURLY_BUDGET_USD. __main__.py:13 also documents the wrong name.
- **Feedback thread compiled off in prod.** The live bundle index-CXPKtaR2.js contains ["1","true","yes"].includes("".toLowerCase()) inside StyleWheel. The prod API build is 874345539, 31 commits behind 15e78e276.
- **Design branches.** SHAs, commit counts and "no PR" (gh pr list --head gives [] for all four) are correct. w1 is an ancestor of w3. Each branch merges cleanly onto main. w3 conflicts with w5 and with w7, only in PanelLayout.tsx; w5 with w7 is clean. None of the four branches has disabledReason.
- **Craft blockers still on main:** index.html:14, tailwind.config.js:12, the PanelLayout.tsx:91 early return before its hooks, MascotStation.tsx:566, and the LemonButton base with no focus-visible.

**Overstated statuses**
- **AD-03:** PARTIAL, not ABSENT. A FloatMenu Note already becomes a user-authored insight node (app.py:2439-2456).
- **CR-04:** PARTIAL. The floating chase panel has an entry spring; only its exit is dead, because it has no AnimatePresence.
- **CR-05:** PARTIAL. The reader's Deep-research navigates to /inv, so it works at phone width but fails silently (console.error). The Research and DRW floating ChaseThread is what disappears at sm.
- **CR-08:** PARTIAL. ParkedQuestion (including its launching state), WatchForLaterFolder, HighlightToolbar, CrossDocSidebar and NotesPanel have stories and lostpixel baselines. The claim that "only ChaseSlideOver/ArtifactFeedbackReview" have stories is false.

**Minor issues**
- ThreadBreadcrumb:69 is an overflow-x scroller, not a hidden class.
- The ReadingCompanion "33/13" counts are line counts.
- The "provider isn't configured" copy is hedged with "usually", but it is still a misattribution.

**Missed capabilities**
- The /wrestle reactive loop: claim challenge starts the grounder automatically, and the cross-doc watcher auto-answers and clears parked questions.
- Note challenge, which escalates a note to an open question with a reserved chase child.
- AutoNotebook (/notebook/auto/:id), a ratified per-investigation companion view with Insights and Open-questions sections. It is the natural base for the per-project companion document.
- DRW structural gap detection. Only Speak's interviewer context consumes it; plan_from_gap has no callers.
- The cascade spend-preview/spend-approval consent flow in CascadeProposal.
- A daily arXiv OAI sync timer, which is system-level scheduled re-ingestion.
- POST /events/typed accepts investigation.start_requested with chase_mode, and also question.identified. That makes chase_mode reachable through the API and skips the run_capacity_precheck that POST /investigations runs. I did not run this end to end.

**Honesty and craft defects it missed**
- The Notebook "Add question card" dialog says the question "will surface as a parked question". Nothing emits question.identified, so it never does.
- SuggestedResearch's true empty state renders through AIActionFailure. That is role=alert and aria-live=assertive in red, so an empty state is styled and announced as an error.
- MenuButton in FloatMenu has no focus-visible style.
- A global Esc handler likely discards an unsaved Note draft. I read this in the code; I did not run it.

**Not run**
vitest and storybook, because apps/reading/node_modules is absent. The prod daemon process state was not measured.

**Housekeeping**
The only thing I wrote was scratch data under /tmp/mothership-ground/autonomy-and-craft-baseline-refute/. The one side effect was a git fetch of the four design branches, which updated their remote-tracking refs. This subagent did not message the 'Antiek Sweep' session. The orchestrator owns that handoff.
